label: Quiet (distance from highway/airport noise)
unit: km to nearest interstate or airport
description: PROXY, not measured noise: straight-line distance from the town center point to the nearest interstate highway (OSM highway=motorway with ref 'I-') or airport with an IATA code (OSM aeroway=aerodrome), whichever is closer. Larger = farther from major transport noise sources. Measured at a single city-center point, so large towns that span highways are understated.
